name: ElevateStore for WooCommerce – Product Codes, Barcodes, Badges & Order Tools
author: WesternDeal

sections.description:
ElevateStore for WooCommerce is a growing WooCommerce store management toolkit that adds product codes, barcode generation, product badges, order duplication, and other productivity features to your store.
Manage custom product identifiers beyond the standard WooCommerce SKU, generate and print product barcodes, duplicate WooCommerce orders, and display customizable product badges — all from one plugin.
ElevateStore is designed for WooCommerce store owners, administrators, warehouse teams, and developers who want practical tools to simplify everyday product and order management.

WooCommerce Product Codes

Need a custom product identifier in addition to the standard WooCommerce SKU?
ElevateStore adds an independent Product Code system to WooCommerce. Create product codes manually or generate them automatically using configurable prefixes.
Product codes can be used throughout your store, including product pages, cart, checkout, orders, emails, invoices, and the WooCommerce admin.
Product Code Features

• Add custom product codes to WooCommerce products.
• Automatically generate product codes.
• Automatically generate codes for product variations.
• Configure product-type based prefixes.
• Support for Simple products.
• Support for Variable products.
• Support for individual Variations.
• Support for Grouped products.
• Support for External/Affiliate products.
• Display product codes on product pages.
• Display product codes in the cart.
• Display product codes during checkout.
• Display product codes in order details.
• Display product codes in WooCommerce order emails.
• Display product codes on invoices and packing slips.
• Add a Product Code column to the WooCommerce Products admin screen.
• Bulk generate product codes.
• Bulk delete product codes.
• Search WooCommerce products by product code.
• Filter products with a Product Code.
• Filter products without a Product Code.
• Customize product code field labels.
• Customize admin column labels.
• Prevent duplicate product codes.
• Validate product codes.
Product Codes work independently from WooCommerce SKUs, allowing you to keep your existing SKU structure while maintaining another identifier for internal operations, suppliers, warehouses, catalogs, or customer communication.

WooCommerce Order Duplicator

Need to quickly copy or recreate an existing WooCommerce order?
The Order Duplicator lets administrators duplicate WooCommerce orders without manually entering the same customer, product, shipping, fee, or coupon information again.
You can duplicate individual orders or copy multiple WooCommerce orders using bulk actions.
Order Duplication Features

• Duplicate an order from the Order Actions dropdown.
• Duplicate an order directly from the WooCommerce orders list.
• Bulk duplicate multiple WooCommerce orders.
• Copy order items and order information.
• Optionally duplicate order notes.
• Optionally duplicate coupons.
• Optionally duplicate fees.
• Optionally duplicate shipping information.
• Choose the status assigned to duplicated orders.
• Supports Draft status.
• Supports Pending payment status.
• Supports Processing status.
This can be useful when recreating customer orders, processing repeat orders, testing order workflows, or creating a new order based on an existing WooCommerce order.

WooCommerce Barcode Generator

Generate barcodes for WooCommerce products using your existing product codes.
ElevateStore includes a Product Barcode Generator that can automatically create product barcodes and QR codes, display them throughout WooCommerce, and generate printable barcode labels.
Supported Barcode Types

• Code 128.
• Code 39.
• EAN-13.
• EAN-8.
• UPC-A.
• UPC-E.
• QR Code.
Choose the barcode format you want to use across your store.
Barcode Features

• Automatically generate barcodes from product codes.
• Generate barcodes for WooCommerce products.
• Generate barcodes for product variations.
• Preview barcodes on product edit screens.
• Preview barcodes on variation edit screens.
• Display barcodes on WooCommerce product pages.
• Display barcodes on shop pages.
• Display barcodes in the cart.
• Display barcodes during checkout.
• Display barcodes in My Account orders.
• Display barcodes in order details.
• Display barcodes in WooCommerce emails.
• Display barcodes in WooCommerce admin orders.
• Display barcodes on invoices and packing slips.
• Enable or disable barcode display for individual locations.
• Automatically update the barcode when a variation is selected.
• Bulk print barcode labels.
• Printable barcode label page.
Barcode Customization
Control how your WooCommerce barcodes appear with options for:

• Barcode width.
• Barcode height.
• Margin.
• Quiet zone.
• Barcode colors.
• Alignment.
• Human-readable text.
• Product code caption.
• Product name caption.
• Live barcode preview.
These options make it easier to create barcodes suitable for product packaging, labels, inventory workflows, warehouses, retail operations, and internal product identification.

WooCommerce Product Badges

Highlight important products with customizable WooCommerce Product Badges.
ElevateStore lets you manually assign badges or automatically display badges based on product information, stock levels, sales activity, and other conditions.
Manual Product Badges
Add badges to Simple, Variable, Variation, Grouped, and External products.
Available badge options include:

• Sale.
• New.
• Featured.
• Bestseller.
• Low Stock.
• Custom text.
Automatic Product Badges
Automatically display badges such as:

• Sale.
• New Arrival.
• Featured.
• Best Seller.
• Low Stock.
• Out of Stock.
• Limited Stock.
• Trending.
• Recently Added.
• Popular.
Manual, automatic, custom-text, and dynamic sales-data driven badge sources can be enabled or disabled independently.
Product Badge Display Locations
Choose where WooCommerce product badges appear:

• Shop pages.
• Product category pages.
• Single product pages.
• Search results.
• Related products.
• Upsells.
• Cross-sells.
• Cart.
• Checkout.
Badge Design & Appearance
Customize product badges with controls for:

• Badge text.
• Text color.
• Background color.
• Shape.
• Position.
• Border radius.
• Font size.
• Padding.
• Animation.
• Shadow.
Advanced Badge Controls

• Hide badges on mobile devices.
• Hide badges for logged-out users.
• Hide badges when products are out of stock.
• Display multiple badges.
• Configure badge priority.
Product badges can help shoppers quickly identify sales, new arrivals, featured products, popular products, best sellers, and stock availability.

Why ElevateStore for WooCommerce?

WooCommerce provides the essential features needed to run an online store, but many stores need additional tools for everyday product and order management.
Installing a separate plugin for every small store-management task can add unnecessary complexity.
ElevateStore brings multiple practical WooCommerce tools together in one plugin.
Use ElevateStore to:

• Create product identifiers separate from WooCommerce SKU.
• Generate and manage product barcodes.
• Print barcode labels.
• Duplicate existing WooCommerce orders.
• Highlight products with customizable badges.
• Improve product and order management workflows.
• Reduce repetitive WooCommerce administration tasks.
ElevateStore is built as a growing WooCommerce toolkit, allowing additional store-management features to be added while keeping related functionality in one place.

Who Is ElevateStore For?

ElevateStore can be useful for:

• WooCommerce store owners.
• Store administrators.
• eCommerce managers.
• Warehouse teams.
• Inventory managers.
• Retail businesses.
• Wholesale stores.
• Stores managing large product catalogs.
• Developers managing WooCommerce stores for clients.
Whether you need custom product codes, printable barcodes, faster order duplication, or flexible product badges, ElevateStore provides these tools from one WooCommerce plugin.

Why use this plugin?

Running a WooCommerce store often requires multiple plugins for product identification, order management, barcode generation, and product promotions. Managing several plugins increases complexity, affects performance, and makes store administration more difficult.

ElevateStore for WooCommerce brings these essential store management tools together in one lightweight plugin.

Whether you need custom product codes for inventory, duplicate customer orders in a few clicks, generate printable product barcodes, or highlight products with attractive badges, ElevateStore helps streamline your daily WooCommerce workflow.

Benefits

  • Manage product codes independently from WooCommerce SKUs.
  • Duplicate WooCommerce orders quickly without recreating them manually.
  • Generate and print product barcodes for inventory and retail operations.
  • Increase product visibility with customizable badges.
  • Reduce repetitive admin tasks and improve productivity.
  • Configure each feature independently from a single settings page.
  • Designed to grow with new WooCommerce management tools in future releases.

ElevateStore is built for WooCommerce store owners, warehouse teams, wholesalers, retailers, and developers who want practical tools to simplify product and order management while keeping their store organized and efficient.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/elevatestore-for-woocommerce/ directory, or install through WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > ElevateStore.
  4. Enable Advanced Product Code.
  5. Configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this replace WooCommerce SKU?

No. Product Code works separately from SKU.

Does it support variable products?

Yes. It supports variable products and variation-level product codes.

Can I auto-generate product codes?

Yes. Auto-generation can be enabled from plugin settings.

Can I bulk generate product codes?

Yes. Bulk actions are available in WooCommerce products list.

Can I search products by product code?

Yes. Product code search is supported in admin products screen.

Can I duplicate an order?

Yes. Enable Order Duplicator in settings, then duplicate an order from the Order Actions dropdown, the orders list row action, or the bulk actions menu.

Does the plugin generate barcodes?

Yes. Enable Product Barcode in settings to auto-generate barcodes (Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, or QR Code) from your product codes, preview them on the product/variation edit screens, show them across the frontend and admin, and print barcode labels in bulk.

Is Product Badge available yet?

Yes. Enable Product Badge in settings to add manual badges to your products, turn on automatic badge rules, choose where badges appear, and customize their appearance.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

1 August 2026
* Initial release
* Added advanced product code system
* Added bulk generate and delete
* Added frontend display settings
* Added product code filters
* Added variation product code support
* Added: Order Duplicator module — duplicate orders individually or in bulk, with a configurable duplicated-order status and optional copying of notes, coupons, fees, and shipping
* Added: Product Barcode Generator module — Code128 barcode preview on product and variation edit screens, frontend barcode display, and a “Print Barcode Labels” bulk action with a standalone printable labels page
* Added: Custom “Draft” order status used by Order Duplicator
* Updated: Plugin description, FAQ, and screenshots to document the Order Duplicator and Product Barcode Generator modules
* Note: Product Badge remains a settings preview only ; full badge functionality is still in development
* Fixed: Order Duplicator and Product Barcode Generator settings now hide when their module toggle is switched off, matching Advanced Product Code
* Added: Product Badge settings UI preview (marked “Upcoming” in the sidebar ; not yet functional)
* Renamed the plugin to “ElevateStore for WooCommerce”.
* Updated branding and plugin metadata.
* General maintenance improvements.
* Enhanced: Product Barcode Generator with support for multiple barcode formats.
* Added: Real-time barcode preview in the Product Barcode Generator settings.
* Added: Product Badge module with support for text badges and image badges.
* Added: Built-in badge library and custom badge image support.
* Added: Live badge preview and improved badge customization options.
* Improved: Module settings UI and overall user experience.
* Fixed: Minor bugs and code improvements.
